note: Sung, Komuravelli & Adve (DeNovoND, ASPLOS 2013) state their disciplined-non-determinism (lock-based) design guarantees sequential consistency, so on the data-race-free fragment it admits exactly the SC outcomes. Like DeNovo it assumes software supplies race-freedom and defines no behaviour for racy programs; the value-add over DeNovo is the coherence design (locks / access signatures), not the consistency class.
